edits.anchor: The summer version of this cottage gets the reviews: the dock, the sauna, the long sunset over the creek. But winter clears the calendar and drops the rates, and it hands you a completely different cast of characters on the same water.
edits.before: The summer version of this cottage gets the reviews: the dock, the sauna, the long sunset over the creek. But winter clears the calendar and drops the rates, and it hands you a completely different cast of characters on the same water.
edits.after: The summer version of this cottage gets the reviews: the dock, the sauna, the long sunset over the creek. Winter hands you a completely different cast of characters on the same water, just as worth the trip.
edits.note: Removed all reference to rates, the calendar clearing/being empty, and off-season framing. Rewrote as abundance (a different, equally worthwhile set of wildlife on the same water) rather than a downside-then-reassurance shape, per voice principle #1. Kept the wildlife-sightings-hull-creek link in place.
